specId.fullTitle: MEP Equipment Handover for Facility Management - Use case

authoring.copyright: Copyright 2026 Building Informatics Group (BIG), Yonsei University. Sample for testing; not normative.

description.title: At substantial completion the MEP contractor hands over an asset register of maintainable equipment, with warranty, document and maintenance information, for loading into the owner's CMMS.
Aim: deliver complete, checkable MEP asset data at handover instead of paper O&M binders.
Scope: maintainable HVAC, plumbing, fire protection and electrical equipment. Furniture and IT assets are out of scope.
Verified asset register accepted by the owner.
MEP asset handover data as defined in the exchange requirement.
CMMS populated with equipment, warranties and planned maintenance tasks.

businessRule.name: Asset tag format and uniqueness
businessRule.statement: Every equipment asset tag shall follow the pattern Building-System-Type-Sequence (e.g. B01-HVAC-AHU-001) and shall be unique within the facility.

image.caption: Asset tag label on an air handling unit

description.title: Commentary: the sequence number has three digits and restarts for each equipment type.

businessRule.name: Mandatory manufacturer data
businessRule.statement: Manufacturer and model number shall be provided for every equipment type.

businessRule.name: Serial number for components
businessRule.statement: A serial number shall be provided for every installed equipment component.

businessRule.name: Spatial location
businessRule.statement: Every equipment component shall be located in exactly one space.

description.title: Commentary: roof-mounted equipment is assigned to the roof space.

businessRule.name: Warranty start date
businessRule.statement: The warranty start date shall equal the date of substantial completion unless the contract states otherwise.

businessRule.name: Minimum warranty duration
businessRule.statement: Warranty duration shall be expressed in months and shall be at least 12 months.

businessRule.name: Planned maintenance task
businessRule.statement: Every equipment type shall have at least one planned maintenance task with a frequency greater than zero.

description.title: Shorter mobilisation of facility operations; no manual re-keying of asset data.
Spare parts and resource lists are not covered in this version.
IFC 4.3 or COBie export; owner's CMMS import template.
